pages.text: Whenever you use a diagram to work with spirits, it will increase your affinity for that spirit type and decrease it for the opposing type. The greater your affinity, the faster those spirits will move in your diagrams.$(br2)You can check your affinity by throwing a hallow into water: it will float at a height proportional to your affinity for its spirit type.

Opposing spirit pairs are Earth and Air, Fire and Cold, Phlogiston and Water, Light and Dark, Protection and War, Food and Death, Flesh and Tech, Nature and Fortune, Fate and Time, White and Black, Gray and Light Gray, Lime and Purple, Brown and Pink, Orange and Light Blue, Red and Cyan, Green and Magenta, and Blue and Yellow. Nether opposes Overworld, End opposes Nether, and Overworld opposes End.

There's a limit to the affinity you can gain by using spirits in diagrams. You can only exceed this limit by permanently committing via one of the $(l:otherverse:rituals)Big Three Rituals$(). Once you do, not only will spirits move faster, but you'll start extracting extra spirits from items. You can max out your affinity by using the same spirit type in all three rituals.
